s: Which of the following was the capital of Andhra State when it was made a separate state in the year 1953?
x: In an effort to gain a separate state based on linguistic grounds, Potti Shriramulu fasted until death in 1952. After Shriramulu's death, the Telugu speaking areas of Andhra state were carved out of Madras state in October, 1953 with Kurnool as its capital city. Later in 1956, Hyderabad was made the capital of Andhra Pradesh. Andhra Pradesh was bifurcated in 2014 and a separate state of Telangana was formed.
